decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix lies far from the firm's waste-to-energy technology focus, and there is no evidence after 2019 of its value being realized, so with many other venture options its resources are better redeployed.
Modular plant extensions complement the core WASTX platform and cost little to keep offered, so the option is worth holding while demand for decentralized energy remains uncertain.

As a flagship decentralized waste-oil solution with its own page and launch press, its prospects are still unresolved and it anchors the firm's strategic direction, which justifies keeping the option open.
Plastic-to-fuel is a growing flagship area with high strategic upside and rising attention to plastic waste, so the option's value under continuing uncertainty clearly exceeds its carrying cost.
